string.text: Hey! Wait, don't shoot! I'm not a zombie!
Stalker...! Wait! Don't shoot!
What?! Who the hell are you? Are you even alive?
I don't even know what to say anymore. I feel alive, yet... not quite. Like something's missing.
What are you talking about? What happened to you?

I don't even know what to tell you. 
 
It feels like I'm alive, but not really. Like I'm stuck in limbo. I don't remember anything except some vague flashes. My first clear memory is a bright flash... then I woke up at the Doctor's place in the swamp. He told me I got caught in a powerful blast and somehow survived. I stayed with him for a couple of weeks until I recovered, and now I'm just... here. 
 
I thought about going back to the Mainland, but what's the point? I don't even remember what it looks like. I think I have family there somewhere, but how the hell would I find them? 
 
And here... there's no one to really talk to. Everyone's sullen and paranoid, like they're just waiting for the right moment to stab you in the back. The only exception was that one guy - the Journalist. He seemed decent, unusually friendly for the Zone. But he was strange... always asking weird questions, prying into everything, dragging around a huge pile of papers like they were his lifeline. I wonder where he is now.
A journalist? Tell me more about him.

I've been stuck in this dump longer than I can count, living off nothing but grilled rats and crows. \n \nDo me a favor and bring me some real food - say, two loaves of bread - and I'll share everything I know. I can't go get it myself. The Freedom boys aren't exactly my biggest fans, if you catch my drift.
Alright.
Bye.

So here's what happened... I heard a famous stalker died in this boiler room. Local legend and all that. 
 
Thought I'd poke around and maybe score some good loot. Figured a guy like that wouldn't go down without something worthwhile on him. I went inside, found an entrance going underground, and... well, I got turned around pretty bad. 
 
You have no idea how glad I am to see you! I've been lost in here almost a full day. Please, man - get me out or show me the way. I won't forget this!

Yeah, no problem. \n \nSee over there? Take the left turn. After that, just go straight the whole way - no side paths, don't go into any rooms. Keep going until you see stairs on your right. Those will lead you out.
Thanks a million, man! I owe you big time - I''ll be in your debt for the rest of my life. \n \nI'm never setting foot in this damn dungeon again. To hell with these catacombs!
Hey, you seen any live stalkers around here?

No, man. No matter how much I wander around, it's all the same down here. Just rats and skeletons. Nothing else interesting. Kind of a bummer, honestly... \n \nListen, I think I'll head out. I can't stand this place anymore. Thanks again, for real!
You paged me?

Well look at that - you made it back in one piece, buddy. Ha! Solid work delivering the box. I like people who follow through. \n \nBarkeep needs a bit more time to figure shit out... you know the drill. Meantime, I've got something to discuss with you.
What's going on?

One of my acquaintances dropped by earlier. Said he was heading out to Yantar. 
 
I could tell the idiot was as good as dead, but I kept my mouth shut - if a man wants to get himself killed, who am I to stop him? Sure enough, the smartass never even made it. Vanished somewhere on the road to the Research Institute. 
 
We didn't hear shit from him for a whole week... until one of my couriers spotted him under a bridge at night.
Yeah, interesting story... but what does any of that have to do with me?

Look, I'm not telling you stories for fun. 
 
Few days ago I saw on my PDA that the guy was dead! Now he's showing up under the bridge at night like nothing happened. Something's off and it's starting to annoy the shit out of me. 
 
You're my go-to man, so handle it. He only appears at night. Locals knew him well and now they're too spooked to go near the place. Because of this mess I'm losing business, and that's the last thing I need right now.
So, what should I do about it?

Oh, I don't know... 
 
I already told you - I don't need that fucker hanging around here. Just get rid of him, got it? Do it any way you like, feed him to an anomaly for all I care. 
 
You handle this and you'll have my goodwill... plus a nice bribe, of course.
Fine. Let's see what this "dead man walking" actually looks like.

You'll need to talk to the Jackal. He knows exactly where the stash is - inherited it from the Fox. 
 
I hope you haven't forgotten the bridge is guarded by a sniper right now. Try sneaking across and you'll get dropped in a heartbeat. 
 
So you go through the sewer pipe on the left side of the bridge. Once you cross the embankment, hit me up right away through your PDA contacts. And keep it short - don't give them time to spot you.
Why are you acting so coy? Is there a catch somewhere? \n \nAh, to hell with it. You're paying well, so I'm in.

Fine, suit yourself! I'll toss you some scraps and send you packing. But mark my words - without cash or a steady job you won't survive a week out here. Good thing I've got both ready for you. 
 
Listen up: there's an interesting stash behind the railway tracks. Bring me whatever decent loot you find and I'll make it worth your while. Then you can go play hero deeper in the Zone. 
 
I can tell you're a straight shooter. So do we have a deal? 500 rubles sound good to you?

The Monolith? 
 
Oh, there's no shortage of crazy rumors about that thing. 
 
One stalker was going on about it the other day - said it's basically the foundation of all human wishes and desires. Something unique everyone strives for... The damn quintessence, or whatever the hell he called it.

Hey, I'm still talking, don't interrupt me! 
 
He was throwing around a bunch of smart words, I don't remember half of them. Truth is I wasn't paying much attention - just nodded along while he dumped his loot in my storeroom. 
 
But now I think the guy might've been onto something. Look how many stalkers chase after the Monolith, and each one sees his own dream in it. Way better than that dumb crap about it being left by aliens.
There you go asking again! \n \nSome of these idiots watch too many American space movies or read too much Strugatsky crap and now they're convinced the Monolith is straight-up alien technology.
Look, Messer, I ain't no expert on all that bullshit. \n \nGo talk to the others yourself. They'll fill your head with a lot more stories than I ever could.

Of course! They're the main commodity around here. Eggheads want them, big shots chase their crazy desires, and the cultists are always hunting them too... \n \nAnyway, that's beside the point. You bring me artifacts and I'll pay you good money. Bring something really special and I might even sweeten the deal.

Good grief, you're such a handful! Okay, fine - you're a bit of a slacker, but not completely hopeless. You'll catch on quick, so listen up. 
 
Have you noticed all the wildlife roaming around here? Think they're useless? That all they do is bite stalkers in the ass? Think again! 
 
If one of those critters stumbles into an anomaly, there's a chance an artifact might be born from it. It's nothing short of a miracle, isn't it?

Sounds like you get the idea, so let's get down to business. 
 
I need a low-grade gravity artifact... and a medium one - the standard kind. Whole area is crawling with them, like goddamn stray dogs. 
 
Bring me one and I'll buy it at a premium price. But if you manage to get both, I'll hook you up with something extra special, just for you. So, what do you say?

Thanks a lot, man! We honestly thought you bailed on us. 
 
Patrol saw something strange by the bridge - human-sized and glowing like crazy. We thought it might be a valuable artifact, so we moved in closer... next thing we know, everything went dark. 
 
No idea how we got here. We'll get our shit together and move out.

Hey, stalker! Hold up! We're trapped in the tunnel here! \n \nWe've been trying to call for help for nearly a day, but these fucking anomalies keep blocking the signal. Switch on your PDA - I'll tell you what's going on.

Watch your step, there's heavy anomalous activity all around. Stray even a little and you're dead meat. And don't forget the bolts! \n \nAlso, I caught a weird signal near the railroad tunnel. Like a distress call, but all fucked up and distorted. Go see what could be causing this.
A package from the "Stalker" bar.
A heavy sealed container. Stamped on the side is the inscription: "To Toad, from Rat. No. 138".
Looks like those thugs decided to give him a good soaking in the well. \n \nHere, grab your box.
Heh-heh... You know, those guys actually have a sense of humor. \n \nThat idiot stank so bad I had to shoo the flies out of my cellar! Anyway, give me the box and here's your cut.
I went and checked that derailed diesel locomotive.
Well? What happened?
A strange mutant had made itself at home on the train, but I took care of the bastard. There shouldn't be any problems getting through from here on out.
Yeah... So that's all you got? No artifacts? Whatever, doesn't matter. Here, take the suit as promised. Let's hope the damn thing holds up against the radiation out there.
Found some weird artifact and a mutant hanging around there. Dealt with the mutant, no problem. As for the artifact - here you go, take it.

You actually took down that beast - not bad! 
 
But this little thing right here... now this is way more interesting. Hand it over. 
 
Listen, I've heard about artifacts like this one. You throw it on the ground and shoot it... the damn thing flies off like a bat out of hell and'll rip through anyone or anything standing nearby. Yeah, you heard me right - this thing can be used as a weapon. Might come in real handy out there.
I've got some gear for the trip to the Research Institute, but it doesn't look very suitable. It needs reparing. Can you help me sort this out?

Yeah, got some tools here. I don't mess with repairs much - the guy in the Bar is the true master, best repairman around. Me? I do it just for the hell of it. 
 
Anyway, give me your suit... Hmm... 
 
This repair's gonna cost you:
Alright, let's get it fixed.
Damn, I don't have enough money right now. Should I just come back later?
Here, I think he's okay now.
There you go, all done. I patched it up nice and proper. Should hold together out there.
Well, great... Everything seems to be fine.
Alright.
Are we there yet?
Yeah, we're here. Take a moment and check your gear again.
Ready to keep moving?
There's a gate on the left. Go through it, I'll be right behind you. I just need to change my clothes real quick. Head on ahead - I'll catch up in a minute. Don't worry about me.
I'll catch up, don't worry.
You ready to go?

Yeah, let's roll. You've been to the Garbage before, haven't you? Still, better we stick together. You got proper combat gear on you? Alright then, we can move out. \n \nThe merchant's relying on us, so don't go playing hero. Though... if we spot any easy bribes, we should grab 'em.
I think we're good to go.
Alright, I've been through here a few times. Stay close, follow me, and cover my back. Usually it's calm, but you never know what the hell might crawl out from the heart of the Zone. Ready to move?
Let's get moving. [fast travel]
Let's get moving.
Do you have a decent suit for the trip to the Research Institute?

Hah, funny you ask. I've got one right here. Belonged to some idiot who thought he could wander into the Garbage without a detector. Stalker brought the suit in recently, bragging it was 'almost intact.' Had to scrape the previous owner out of it, but after a couple evenings of work it's solid again.
You have the suit, right... So how much are you asking for it?

Don't sweat it, I patched it up properly, disinfected everything, did it all by the book. You'll get used to the smell soon enough. \n \nBut let's get to business. You know that wrecked locomotive that's been sitting on the side of the railway embankment for years? A stalker passing by picked up some kind of strange pulsation near it. Simple job: go check out what the hell it is. If it's an artifact, bring it back to me. You do that, and the suit is yours.
Not really in the mood for a partner on this raid. I work better solo.
You don't strike me as stupid, but you're gonna regret going alone when you need someone to cover your ass. You absolutely sure?
Yeah, I'm sure I can handle it myself.
Fine. Just remember - if shit hits the fan, I'm not sending anyone after you! You're on your own.
The beast in the village is dead. I took care of it.

Weird shit's been going on... First the Flesh, then a Controller, and now some new freak at the Cordon. Fuck me... The Zone's acting strange lately. I've been here a long time, and this is new even for me.
You promised me a suit, remember?

Yeah, yeah, keep your pants on. Here it is. Just don't let that same crybaby bring it back to me in a week like last time. Get your ass over to Agroprom already - how long are you gonna keep stalling?!
My raiding partner needs a suit too. Can you help us out?
Hah, listen to this guy... I've got a couple good suits, but they're probably too expensive for you. Though...
Come on, get to the damn point!

Fine. Some nasty creature has settled in the little village left of the bridge. Extremely bloodthirsty. Anyone who's laid eyes on it didn't live long enough to describe it. The locals say the branches are decorated with human guts. \n \nYou're a bold one, always scurrying back and forth... Tell you what - take out that beast and the suit is yours.
I'll give it a try. But I can't promise anything.
About that trip to the Research Institute...
Well? Is there a problem or something?
No, forget it. Never mind.
Alright, carry on then!
Hey! You still alive? Can you talk or should I have the boys haul you back to where they found you?
Hey. What are you doing here?

Stalker, you gotta help me! I bumped into two guys coming from the Garbage. Thought they were friendly, but they were thugs. Cocky as hell. I was holding my Kalashnikov and they just ripped it out of my hands before I could do anything. Luckily they didn't shoot me - just fired at my feet, so I turned tail and ran!
So what can I do for you?

I followed them for a bit. They headed somewhere behind the factory... 
 
Listen, you're always around there anyway - maybe you could give those bastards a warm welcome for me? All I need is my AK back. Though honestly, I don't even know if they still have it. 
 
Get me any decent AKMS and I won't forget it. Just... don't get me wrong, but if you fuck around with it for too long, I'll take it as a betrayal. Keep that in mind. I need it back as soon as possible, okay?
Hey, stalker. I've got a question for you.
Hey, mate. Thanks again for the gun! So, what's up?
I'm putting together a raid on the Agroprom Research Institute. Need a solid partner to cover my back in case shit hits the fan. You interested?

To Agroprom? Hmm... why not? As you can see, my gear isn't exactly up to the task. To reach the Research Institute I'll need at least a proper Stalker jumpsuit. Radiation there is supposed to be brutal. \n \nHere's the deal: you get me a decent jumpsuit and we'll head out right away. Deal?
About your rifle...
What's up?
Here's your Kalashnikov back.

No way, you actually got it! Thanks, man - you're a lifesaver! \n \nI'm heading back to the village to tell everyone you helped me out. You should stop by sometime - maybe we can work together again. I'm actually thinking of hitting the Garbage soon.
I got you a jumpsuit.
Nice! That works for me. I'll change my gear once we get to the Junkyard. \n \nWhat do you say - ready to move out right now?
You do know how to handle a gun, right?

Ha! You're asking if I can handle a gun? I've handed out beatings to bastards you wouldn't even have nightmares about! \n \nAnyway, don't forget to grab a jumpsuit for yourself. As soon as you're ready, we'll move out.
Hey, are you up for an expedition to the Agroprom Research Institute?
What? Go with you? So you can shoot me in the back the first chance you get? Yeah, that's just what I fucking need!
But, I could use-...
No! Get the fuck out of here right now - before I put a bullet through your thick skull!
I found it - but screw that. I think I'll just keep it for myself!
Figures... That's what I get for asking for help. Fine, go on - go enjoy yourself. We'll meet again, don't you worry...
I haven't found it yet.
Those bastards are hanging out behind the factory. Go give them a proper beating, yeah?
This is our territory... What are you doing here?
Well, shit... what a mess. I've got this assignment... I gotta get hold of some papers.

Papers? We've got absolutely no use for them. But we do have something for you - a shotgun we put together ourselves. It's right nearby. \n \nYou can have it, but only if you help us out. Some stalker showed up at our sanctuary site. There's a storeroom there packed with heavy crates we can't move. Take this - it'll help with the lifting. Clear the rubble, chase the intruder off, then come back. We'll talk after that.
Uh... What exactly do you need me to do?
As I just said... clear out the crates and chase the fool off. The coordinates are already marked on your PDA.
Well, looks like everything's ready now...
Everything is in order now... We will keep our word. \n \nIt seems... you are worthy of trust. Worthy... of being trusted...
That stalker said he pushed through the Agroprom Research Institute to get here. \n \nOnly god knows how... That place is miserable. He-...

Here. Take it. Go on. 
 
No, wait... there's one more thing. Take this too. It's a medallion. It means more than it looks. Keep it close, don't lose it - and luck won't abandon you. I can promise you that much. 
 
Now go.
Hey. How are things? Still alive and kicking?

Messer! Hey, good to see you, man. Yeah, I'm alright - finally dragged myself to the Bar. It took a while but I got here. 
 
I spread the word about you to some of the guys, told them you're solid. You're welcome. 
 
Listen though - on the way out of the underground I clocked some guys in blue jumpsuits poking around. They didn't spot me, so I didn't stick around to find out just who they were... And get this - some lowlife was camped at the entrance running his own little toll booth. I had to pay him out of my own pocket just to walk through. 
 
These bandit bastards are getting seriously out of hand.

Yeah, yeah - don't mention it, my man. But those blue jumpsuits... that's worth looking into. Not a lot of groups out here running around in matching gear like that. It could be nothing, or could be something I need to know about. \n \nI'll ask around. See if anyone else has spotted them.

Appreciate it. And I mean that. \n \nOut here, your name is everything. Gear rusts, money runs out, but a good reputation? That follows you everywhere. Especially if you're trying to stay honest in the Zone.
Great. I was just coming to see you!

What the hell?! Hey! A stalker! I thought I was done for - completely finished... 
 
You believe this? I found a tunnel entrance back at the Agroprom Research Institute and climbed in... ended up in here somehow. Got completely lost. I wandered around for a day, maybe two - I don't even know anymore. 
 
Then I find a door and think, that's it, I'm saved! Instead, I walk into this place. And the damn door slammed shut right behind me, almost like it did it on purpose. 
 
Now I'm stuck in a room with no way out. Where the hell are we?!
I doesn't matter right now. What matters is getting out of here if you want to live! \n \nThe exit is upstairs. I've already cleared the way. Go!

Yeah... yeah, seriously - thank you. I owe you one. Hell, I owe you more than one! \n \nI'm making straight for the Bar. If you ever come through, try to find me - drinks are on me. I'm going to tell everyone what you did for me!
Go to hell, bastard!
Hey...
Why the hell are you still standing there?! Go get that crate - I swear to god I'll bash your skull in if you make me say it again!
Hurry up! Get a move on!
Phew... I think I got it!
Messer! What the fuck!
What's going on?

Are you insane?! Do you have any clue what you've just done?! I specifically told you - no noise! And now I'm the one who's going to catch hell for it! \n \nYou owe me compensation. And don't even think about denying it, you've got no way out of this!
Hey, what can I say... That's just how it went.
Motherfucker... Looks like we're going to have to close up shop.
What do you need?
Yes! That's the one! Thank you, Stalker - now I can finally head out to the Research Institute properly!

An old-timer made this for me. The guy's a living legend - one of the first stalkers to ever set foot in the Zone, and somehow he's still breathing. He lives out in the Swamps now. I've been to his place, I remember it. Everyone calls him The Doctor, and he damn well lives up to the name as well. Stitches stalkers back together, mutants too. It sounds crazy, I know - but I saw it with my own eyes. \n \nAnyway - take this folder. It's the best I can do. First run I did at the Research Institute, I fell into some bunker by accident. There was some sort of a lab inside, piles junk everywhere, and a few safes. I found this stuffed in one of them. It looked important, so I grabbed it. Here in the Zone, information beats cash every time.
No problem. Alright, I'm off.
So he took it - so what? What do you want from me?

I need you to get that eye back for me. I tried negotiating with the guy myself but got nowhere - he says I'm not offering enough. I could scrape the money together, there are plenty of artifacts to find here in the Garbage, but... 
 
Could you go talk to him for me? He's not far - hangs around the Duty checkpoint. Put some pressure on him while you're there, really lean into it. I think he'll be more cooperative with you. 
 
I'll make it worth your while, I promise.
Could you tell me where I might look for artifacts around here?
Sure, you want the keys to the apartment with all the cash in it too, while I'm at it?
That would be nice!

Oh sure, laugh it up... Artifacts are drying up out here, and I mean seriously drying up. A month back there was nobody around and the things were everywhere - you couldn't take two steps without tripping over one. \n \nThen the greens showed up in force, picked the place clean... and now the prices have gone to hell on top of it. Just perfect.
But what if you really think about it?

Here's what I've figured out - they pop up where people aren't. The more out of the way, the better. Back alleys, abandoned houses, basements, construction sites. Anywhere nobody bothers to check. That's your best bet.
Hey, this information means a lot - thank you!
What's got you so shaken up?
What? Nah... forget it.
Oh quit it, out with it.
Fine, suit yourself.
God... alright, look. So I'm talking to this guy, right - just shooting the shit - and he turns around and hits me with: "How do you even miss an Electro Mincer?"
Yeah, and? Seriously - how do you miss something like that?

There's the punchline. We finish talking, he heads off, disappears behind some junk heap. \n \nFew seconds later I hear a discharge, run over - and there's just a shredded corpse. Electro Mincer right next to him!
How the hell does that happen?
That's the whole point of the story. The Zone does what it wants, so don't get smart with it. Disrespect it, and it'll return the favor tenfold. \n \nSomehow it listens... Believe me on that one.
Then I take my words back - if it's not too late.
Ah, that's all nonsense. The guy just got unlucky, that's all there is to it...
What are you up to?
What's it to you?
Same as everyone else - trying to scrape together a living. What's the alternative, sightseeing? Going mushroom picking?
Of course! Boil them up and they'd probably be just fine...
Yeah, right - and then deal with an ulcer on top of everything else. No thank you...
Heh... Right then, guess I'll go find myself some mushrooms.
You nuts or something?
Get lost, stalker!
Alright, alright, I'm going.
What if I want to do this the hard way?
That's it, you've pushed me too far! I'm gonna wipe the floor with you!
Alright, alright, I'm leaving! Cool it!
Go ahead, try me!
Got any stories to tell?
You've come to the right place! Let me ask you something first - have you ever seen a ghost?
No...? I haven't.
Yes, I have. Very scary...
W-w-what?
Ha - relax, I'm just messing with you! No, I've never seen one.

You little joker, damn it! Well, I've seen one! 
 
I was walking along a tree line one time, spotted an abandoned little house and figured I'd stop there for the night. I went inside, checked everything - clear. I was just about to sit down and eat when I hear the door open. 
 
My heart hit the floor. I grabbed my gun and aimed straight at the doorway... Then this awful cold starts creeping in - the kind that goes right through you. 
 
Bam - a transparent figure of what looked like some old man comes floating out of the other room. It shuffled around for a bit and then just... flew off through the ceiling. 
 
Naturally, I had no interest in spending the night after that. I grabbed my stuff and bolted. Now I don't go near shacks like that at all...

Well, I've seen one! 
 
I was walking along a tree line one time, spotted an abandoned little house and figured I'd stop there for the night. I went inside, checked everything - clear. I was just about to sit down and eat when I hear the door open. 
 
My heart hit the floor. I grabbed my gun and aimed straight at the doorway... Then this awful cold starts creeping in - the kind that goes right through you. 
 
Bam - a transparent figure of what looked like some old man comes floating out of the other room. It shuffled around for a bit and then just... flew off through the ceiling. 
 
Naturally, I had no interest in spending the night after that. I grabbed my stuff and bolted. Now I don't go near shacks like that at all...
Wow! It's interesting... I wonder what kind of unknown force could that even be.
Yeah right, you're making that up!
What's with you? You look half dead.
You wouldn't happen to have any painkillers? My head is absolutely splitting...
Yeah, I should have some. Here, take it.
I've got some, but I can't give you any - already running low as it is.
Ugh, you cheapskate... It's fine, the Zone will remember this!

Thanks, stalker. Can you believe it though - me and my buddy were getting ready for a raid, and they jumped us right there in the hideout. They cracked my friend over the head, but he got lucky - he stayed conscious, so he played dead. Me, I didn't have to pretend. \n \nThose bastards cleaned us out completely. Now I don't know what to do. Spent my last hundred on food yesterday...
Here's another hundred - you'll figure out how to get back on your feet from there... hopefully.
Yeah, it's rough. Well... anyway, good hunting out there, stalker.
Wow, now that's something - thank you, really! Damn, you're alright! May you find your own Klondike out there, and good luck, stalker!
Sorry, I got nothing.
Damn... that sucks. Well, what can you do - can't argue with a no.
Hello.
Hey! So what are we drinking to?
Since when were we drinking?
Uh... no. Well, don't be shy - it's on me! So what are we drinking to?
To vodka losing its one and only flaw - the fact that there's never enough of it! Heh-heh...
Now that's well said. Bottoms up!

Bottoms up! \n \nAhhh, that went down smooth! Hey, you know anything about bandits? Some stalker was telling me about these shady characters, and I didn't believe him - but I'm not exactly keen on finding out for myself either.
Oh man, of all people you had to ask me! You think I actually wanted to check?
Hey, I don't blame you. A buddy of mine said they're total scumbags - barely even human. They've settled in the Garbage, so watch yourself out there!
Alright, I'll manage. Thanks for the vodka - but I've got to keep moving. Take care of yourself, stalker.
What are you so happy about? You're practically glowing - like you just crawled out of the Sarcophagus itself.
I hit it big with artifacts, stalker - real big! Want to hear about it?
Well, to some degree, heh-heh, yeah.
And it wasn't even a Klondike - just a plain old anomaly!
What anomaly? Come on, tell me more.

Just a regular Gravity anomaly cluster, nothing special. I found it out in the Garbage, right by the road to the Bar. 
 
So I'm walking along, minding my own business... and then - bam! A whole pile of artifacts just sitting there, all lit up like a damn Christmas tree! I collected them carefully, sold the lot to the Barkeep. Came back to check a couple hours later - more artifacts! Ended up buying myself a decent suit with the money. 
 
Walking around the Zone in a torn jacket is, to put it mildly, not ideal.
No way, you're pulling my leg!
Cross my heart - that spot is real!
Alright, I'll see about that...
What happened to you? You look like hell.
Damn... stalker, just go away... *Hic* My head is splitting as it is...
Alright, I won't bother you.

Actually, wait... Get this - I'm walking along nice and easy through Dark Valley, and then - bam! *Hic* Everything goes dark... I come to, look around, and I'm already in the Bar... *Hic* What the hell is that about, any idea?
Maybe I know, maybe I don't. I've heard about controllers somewhere - that's the kind of thing they can do. Can't think of anything else it could be.
About... wh-wh-what? Huh...? *Hic*
You heard me, Controllers.
Right! I'll have to ask around and find out what kind of bastard that is... *Hic*
The vodka's not exactly going to help with that, I'd think. But that's your call - take care.
So what's the word? Got anything interesting to share?
Stalker, have you ever heard anything about dwarves?
Sure, I've heard a thing or two...

So a buddy of mine came back recently. He said he and his squad were trying to get into some abandoned lab on their raid. They squeezed in through the ventilation shafts and almost immediately ran into these things.
And what exactly made them think going into a lab was a good idea?

I couldn't tell you, and that's beside the point anyway. Keep listening - they were wandering around in there and stumbled onto some kind of hall. They look in and there's a pile of junk with one of them perched right on top of it, and the others shuffling around below, muttering away.
That's terrifying! Wait, how did they even get out of the lab - didn't those creatures catch their scent?
Oh, they caught their scent alright! They bolted so fast they don't even remember how they got out!
Well, that's something...
Oh come on, you're making this up!
I swear to God, stalker, I'm not lying. Cross my heart!
Doesn't matter - I'll believe it when I see it. See you around.
What were you saying about another job? Is this one really the last?

Last one, I promise. All you need to do is map out a few anomalous zones on the territory between the checkpoint and the railway - and beyond it. Should be easy enough, you've already combed through that area pretty thoroughly. \n \nOnly thing left is a small farmstead to the right of the road - right where you met Ferret.
Sounds simple enough. What's the catch?

The catch is that there's most likely another military patrol sitting under the bridge right now - snipers and all the rest of it. Ever since that incident with the controller, they've been running checks back to back and everyone up the chain is on edge, so don't expect any cooperation from the soldiers. \n \nYou know as well as I do what a run-in with them could mean right now, so I'm strongly advising you to stay out of that area.
Alright, wouldn't be the first time. So how do I take the measurements?

Simple enough. Here, take this thing! It's a device that measures anomalous field activity. Don't go twisting any of the knobs - the eggheads have already calibrated it to the right frequency. All you need to do is walk up to an anomaly, press this button right here, and wait a bit for the device to do its thing. \n \nGot it?
Alright. Sounds easy enough.
Perfect. Come back with the data and I'll have your payment ready. Now get moving!
Kill the controller

Messer, you're our specialist in dealing with controllers - especially after how you handled the factory incident. They say another one showed up from somewhere. Just wandering around, scaring people... No casualties yet, but I've got a bad feeling that won't last. How about you deal with it before things go south?
Toad put out a hit on a controller.
Kill the bloodsucker

Listen, Messer, here's the thing... Near the bridge, there's a bloodsucker that's apparently taken up hunting in the area. Easy pickings out there - nothing but rookies and dogs - so the bastard has gotten fat and bold. The bastard doesn't fear a damn thing, attacks anything that moves, even in broad daylight! 
 
Stalkers are already too scared to leave the village - saying if they head north, the bloodsucker will get them. And that doesn't work for me at all: they sit around doing nothing while my business grinds to a halt! Clients are starting to drive me up the wall - honestly makes me want to throw myself into that thing's mouth myself! 
 
Put it down somehow - I'll make it worth your while, you know me!
Toad put out a hit on a rabid bloodsucker.
So, you gonna be here for long?

Haven't decided yet. I've been thinking about making a move to the Garbage - the military is practically breathing down our necks down here. Something doesn't sit right about it... \n \nThen again, the Garbage is packed with mutants. Duty keeps them in check somewhat, but stalkers don't exactly flock to that place - and for good reason. If some creature doesn't take a chunk out of you, you'll step into an anomaly before you know it.
Alright, I'll keep that in mind.
Who is Jackal? I walked into a trap when I followed his SOS signal.
Jackal? What's the problem? Yeah, there was a guy by that name - seasoned, hard-edged, former soldier. He was trying to find a route to the center of the Zone.
He's dead. The dark ones were waiting for me there.

Dark stalkers? Here? Damn, how did they even get in? That's bad news, I'll tell you that much... They probably used Jackal's PDA as bait to draw you out. If I recall, your last run-in with them didn't end well either... \n \nBut why are they after you specifically? Seems like you really got under their skin at some point - they're not going to this much trouble for nothing.
Maybe we'll see each other again sometime.
Can you tell me anything more about the Bar?

What is there to say? The name pretty much says it all! Alright, fine — for the special ones and the thrice-born, I'll spell it out. \n \nBar "Stalker" is near the Rostok factory. Here, you will find the old housing for the workers that used to work at the factory. As you can imagine, those people are long gone. What's there now is a place where you can stock up on gear, have a conversation, get a drink - whatever you feel like. Duty's base is right nearby too. Strict bunch, but that's exactly what you need to keep order around there. Honestly, it's mostly thanks to them that the Bar hasn't turned into a warzone.
Drinks, you say? That's all well and good, but I'm heading there on business. What I really need to know is whether I can dig up anything about Gunslinger there. Someone's got to know something.

Gunslinger... Hm... Yeah, he's definitely been through there at some point. He might've even had a stash or a hideout somewhere in the area - there's no shortage of abandoned apartments and other spots to hole up in. Take a look around when you can. You never know what's been left behind.
Alright. Worth checking out at least - I'll have a look around when I get there.
So, was there anything interesting in those documents I found?

Turned out to be a report from a military group that fought their way out of the center of the zone. See, after the very first emission - right when the Zone came into existence - they decided to push a major operation north of the station. Over a thousand soldiers, several divisions of equipment, the whole works. 
 
According to the report, the moment this entire force got close to some area with "installations of unknown purpose," another emission hit. There's also an account of what was left of the group scattering across the Zone, plus rough maps of anomalous fields. 
 
It looks like nothing special on the surface, but believe me - this is exactly the kind of information you don't stumble across twice.
Interesting. A thousand soldiers and they still walked right into it. Makes you wonder what was in that area that was worth the risk.
I found some interesting documents. I talked to Toad - he said you're the one to see.

Let's see, what do we have here?... Oh! Messer, you have no idea how valuable what you just brought me is. There's a report here about the military's push to the station back in 2006... \n \nLeave these documents with me - I'll show them to my informant. We'll put our heads together and figure out what to do with all of this.
Here, take them. Hope your informant finds something useful in there.
Toad, I pulled some documents out of that hangar in the Garbage. It looks like there was a major military operation in the Center of the Zone - it's all in there.

What?! Did anyone see you?! And you've got them on you right now? Christ, if the military gets wind of this it's going to be a headache for both of us... Look, I don't have any use for them myself - but Rat, the guy running the Bar "Stalker", he's the one you want to talk to.
Alright, fine. I'll go talk to him and see what he makes of it.
I found the artifact.
Great, did anything strange catch your eye while you were out?
Found a couple of dead soldiers out there. Whatever they were looking for, they didn't find it.
Interesting... What were they even doing out there? Don't tell me they're thinking about another push to the center of the Zone.
A push to the center of the Zone? Can you tell me more about that?

Honestly, I don't know much. Just that it's happened more than once, and every time it ended in a total disaster. If you want the full picture - the Zone's history, the military operations, all of it - your best bet is visiting Bar "Stalker". Someone there will know more than I do.
Maybe I will. Here's your artifact.
Nice job, Messer. That's what I like to see!
What the hell's wrong with me? My head is pounding... Where am I? And what do I owe you?

What could you possibly offer me? When we pulled you out of that burning Death Truck, all you had were those rags on your back. Besides, you don't remember shit anyway. You don't know who you are or where you are. \n \nLet me tell you, my boy... you're in the Zone.
Death Truck...? Boy?! I'm not a boy, and I'm definitely not your boy! Cut that shit out.
Damn right, you are! At least until you work your ass off and earn your keep. I'm the one providing the food, the medicine, and the gun... at least for starters.
Fine... whatever you say. What kind of weapons are you actually gonna give me? At least give me something useful...

Not a goddamn thing, I'm broke as a joke! All I got is the clothes on my back and this PDA. As for the Zone... mate, the Zone is the Zone. No point in me trying to explain it. You gotta see that shit for yourself. \n \nBy the way... does the name Gunslinger mean anything to you?
Gunslinger? ...No. Nothing. Is that supposed to mean something to me?

I see... Sounds like your amnesia is worse than I thought. 
 
Alright, listen up. First thing I need you to do is head over to the checkpoint nearby. Take this sealed metal box and leave it by the barbed wire fence - the spot's marked on your map. Then grab the other box that's waiting there and bring it back. 
 
Don't bother the soldiers. They won't miss a chance for some target practice if they spot you... 
 
You in or what?
Do I have a choice? I'm broke, I don't remember a damn thing, and I'm stuck in the middle of the Zone with nothing but my dick in my hand...!

No, you don't have much of a choice. So... take the box, make the drop at the checkpoint like I said, and bring the other one back. Do it quietly and I'll sort you out with a weapon and some proper gear.
Fine. Give me the box then. Let's get this over with.
That's the spirit! It's right behind you. Hold on - I've got one last question before you go.
Well...? Go on then, spit it out.

So what do I call you? There's been way too many fresh stalkers running around here lately, and I'm not about to keep yelling 'newbie' or 'amnesiac' every time I need you. You got a proper nickname or what?
You can call me whatever you want... Since you can't give me anything better than a knife, just call me Messer.
Here's your box. Nearly got my ass shot off for this thing.

Damn, you actually made it back. You're a survivor, kid. Maybe those old stories about the Death Truck are real - they say anyone who survives it three times is destined to shake up the whole Zone. We'll find out eventually. \n \nYou didn't peek inside the box... right?
Should I have? Hold on - you keep talking about this 'Death Truck'. What the hell is a Death Truck? You've mentioned it a couple times now, so quit being mysterious and tell me what it is.

Alright, keep your hair on... This ain't twenty questions! You turned out alright in the end, so I think we'll get along just fine. 
 
As for the Death Trucks... truth is, nobody really knows the full story. Not even the eggheads over in Yantar. They're those old ZIL trucks that haul people deep into the Zone. Most of the poor bastards inside don't make the trip alive. 
 
That's why everyone calls them Death Trucks, and it's unbelievable that you supposedly survived three of them, kid...

That sounds... very strange. I don't remember any of that shit, but three Death Trucks? That's insane. Guess I'm just lucky... or cursed. Either way, you got any more work for me? I can't keep walking around like this with nothing but a knife.

More work? Hmm... There's a nice artifact that's been sitting in the watchtower right by the old railroad bridge for a while now. 
 
The place is absolutely crawling with strong anomalies - most stalkers are too chickenshit to go anywhere near it. 
 
But you? You seem like you can actually handle yourself. Think you're up for it?

So what do I actually have to do? Head to the railroad bridge, climb that watchtower, snatch the artifact, and bring it back? Sounds straightforward... except for the part where you said the place is crawling with strong anomalies.

Pretty much. Don't forget to use your bolts, you're gonna need them to check for anomalies. 
 
Oh, and I almost forgot... here's some anti-rads and an old anomaly detector. It's running low on juice, but it should be enough for one trip. Keep it on your belt, it discharges pretty quick. 
 
Now stop asking questions and get moving. Don't make me regret giving you this job.
I got the artifact. That watchtower was a nightmare like you warned - the whole area was crawling with anomalies. Took some work, but I brought it back in one piece.
Well, I'll be damned. You actually made it back in one piece. Not bad at all. Hand it over then. I want to see this thing with my own two eyes...
Honestly, I'm surprised I made it back in one piece myself... Here's the artifact. That place was worse than I expected.

There it is! Not bad, kid. Not bad at all. Alright, you earned this. Here, take it. Now move aside - Hoplite's back from Agroprom, and he's already drunk. This one loves talking business when he's hammered.
Hey, Toad... you mentioned hooking me up with a real weapon a while back. I've done a couple jobs for you already, and I still haven't seen shit. What's the deal?
A gun? Huh... What, you planning to go hunting some local mutants or something?
No, that's not what I meant. I just think it's pretty foolish to be running around the Zone with nothing but a knife, that's all.
Scared of blind dogs now, are we? Or is it the crows that keep you up at night?

Look, let's cut to the chase. I'm not gonna stand here and listen to you lecture me, alright? I'm serious, Toad. Running around the Zone with just a knife isn't brave, it's fucking stupid. One wrong step and I'm dead. So either give me a real gun like you promised, or stop wasting my time!

Okay, okay. I'm just messing with you... You're not gonna let this go, huh? 
 
Some drunk stalker came in the other day and left his piece here and never came back for it. Here, take it. 
 
Digger just got back from the Garbage. He's only been in the Zone for two months, but the kid's doing pretty damn well for himself. Been filling a lot of artifact orders lately. So here's the deal - I'll contact him shortly and tell him to give you a quick shooting lesson. He'll be waiting for you in the underpass under the road.
Alright, finally... Thanks for this, even if it is second-hand. I'll head down to the underpass and see what he can teach me.
Alright, go on then, smartass. Try not to shoot yourself in the foot! And don't take forever - I might have another job for you later.
Hey, you're Digger, right? Toad sent me. He said you might be able to give me a shooting lesson.

Yeah, I'm Digger. You're Messer, right? Alright, listen up. There's a Flesh over by the factory that should make for some fine target practice. We're gonna sneak up on the bastard nice and quiet, then take it out clean. You understand?
Got it. A lone Flesh shouldn't be too hard to handle.
You'd be surprised... A Flesh can put up a real fight when there's more than one. Just follow me, stay quiet, and when we get close to the beast, shoot it. Let's go.
I met up with Digger. Decent guy - he showed me the ropes. There was a lone Flesh hanging around the factory... That gun you gave me came in real handy.

Nicely done, kid. It's not much, but it should help you get a better weapon soon. \n \nA Flesh, you say? Hmm, that's strange. They usually don't come down this far from the center of the Zone. I've heard there are whole herds of them running around in that town up north, but around here... they're pretty rare.
A town? Here in the Zone? Interesting. Do people actually live there, or is it overrun by beasts? I'm not sure why someone would want to actually live in this shithole...

Yeah, some people still live up there. Not what you'd call lively though... they're mostly just scraping by day to day. This is the Zone, kid. Folks come here chasing riches, glory, or whatever the hell they dream of... and a lot of them end up dead. \n \nAnyway, I've got a job for you. You interested or what?
You already know the answer. I'm in. What's the job?

That's the spirit! Here's the deal: There's a military raid going on right now, but their last patrol went missing just a short while ago in the factory district. That's pretty unusual - this kind of thing doesn't normally happen. I'm still picking up a clear signal from one of their PDAs, which means at least one of those poor bastards is still alive out there.
You're serious? You want me to go rescue some soldiers? I thought those guys had orders to attack any stalker they see on sight.

Any chance I get to help those bastards, I take it. The way I see it, if we do them a favor now and then, they might go a little easier on us in the future. Besides, I'm picking up an SOS from their commander right now. Go check it out and see what's happening over there.

Fine, you've convinced me. I'll go see what happened to that patrol. But seriously, can you give me a better gun? You have no idea what's waiting for me out there, and I'd prefer not to face it with this peashooter.

No can do, kid. I already gave you everything I had. Of course I don't know what happened to them - I don't even leave this damn bunker. 
 
Tell you what, take this grenade and keep it in your suit pocket so you can grab it fast if shit hits the fan. Here's a first aid kit too, just in case. 
 
And watch your ass out there. There've been some zombies wandering around the plant lately. They're probably being controlled by someone... or something. So be careful.
Hold on a second. Controlling them? What does that even mean? You're telling me someone - or some thing - is controlling those zombies over there?

Maybe. Hell if I know for sure. 
 
Listen, you help me deal with this military shitshow and I'll make it worth your while. You'll get a much better selection of gear from me afterwards. 
 
Now quit stalling and get going.
Hey, are you the commander? What the hell's going on here?
Ahh... shit... A stalker? How the hell did you get here...? I... I didn't call for you. Or did I? Everything's so loud in my head... Get out of here before it... before it gets you too...
What do you mean 'it'? Who showed up? What the hell are you talking about, mate?

The Controller! He's here! He's right up the stairs, I know it! We... we have to find the lieutenant… He went up there! He went up to... to... oh shit... oh fuck... he's in my head again... He's whispering... Get out of here, stalker... before he gets in your head too! Before he makes you... makes you...

Their patrol got ambushed by a Controller. That's what the commander told me, anyway. He was the last one alive when I found him - already losing his mind. He kept rambling about voices in his head controlling him. He still looked pretty rough once I killed the damn thing... but I managed to get him back to the checkpoint safely.

Yeah, I got the confirmation over the radio. They made it back alive. 

Thanks, Messer. I appreciate it. 
 
But a Controller? How the fuck did one of those brain-twisting freaks end up this far south? That's not normal... something feels off about this.

He looked wounded when I found him and went down fast. But that Controller... what the fuck was it doing to my head? A couple times I felt like I couldn't control my own arms when I got near it. \n \nYou said you'd give me information if I did this job. So let's hear it.

The Controller's influence on the brain? Yeah, some say when you get close, you can't even pull the trigger or work the action of your gun. Nasty stuff. 
 
Anyway... here, take this. Some food and a couple jars of Jelly. Don't eat that shit, heh. Throw the jar and it'll create a new anomaly where it lands. Just don't use it in the village. 
 
I've got things to do, so go take a walk for a few hours. I'll call you when I'm ready. 
 
Oh, and before you go - Poopy and Blue just got back from the Garbage. They're hanging around the village right now. If you want, go talk to them. Maybe they know something about this 'Gunslinger' of yours... or they can at least tell you useful shit about the Garbage. You'll be heading there sooner or later anyway.
Alright, I got it. You got any other jobs for me?

Yeah, head over to the bridge. The client, Ferret, is waiting for his delivery and he'll pay on the spot. 
 
I think he just got back from a raid... or maybe he stole the stuff, who knows. Either way, he'll have the cash. 
 
Don't run your mouth with him, Messer. Ferret's a clever bastard. If you hesitate or piss him off, he'll throw you right back where we found you... and this time, nobody's gonna save you. 
 
We give him the ammo, he gives us what we want. Simple. 
 
Now get moving.
Okay, I'll go meet him. I hope he isn't as unforgiving as you make him out to be...

You'll be fine, kid. He's in the lone abandoned house by the bridge. Just give him the ammo, hold your tongue, and you won't have any problem. 
 
Ferret only gets nasty when people waste his time or try to screw him over. 
 
Stop stalling and go.
Toad sent me. Here's the ammo. By the way... who's that military guy? Damn bastard...

That one? He's from the patrol we hit earlier. The bastard must've gotten away somehow. They've been drinking too much stalker blood lately, those bitches... Next time they come into the Zone, we'll show them how to organize a proper punitive operation! \n \nBy the way... is it true what they say? That you're the only survivor of the Death Truck?
That's a lie. I'm not really dead. At least... I don't think I am. People keep telling me I'm the only one who's ever survived the Death Truck. Guess that means most folks figure I should be dead.

That's a good answer. Most people who come back from the Death Trucks either go completely insane or start claiming they're some kind of chosen one. You just sound confused. Interesting. \n \nSo tell me, 'not-really-dead'... what do you actually remember about those trucks? Or is your head still as empty as a fresh grave?

I wish I could tell you. Truth is, I don't remember shit about the trucks... or anything before waking up here. People keep telling me I survived three of them, but it's all blank. Just a big empty hole where my memories should be. So no, I'm not claiming to be chosen or special. I'm just trying to figure out who the hell I am... and why everyone looks at me like I'm a walking ghost.
So you really don't remember anything? Not the trucks, not who you were... nothing. Just a big blank. I see... \n \nThey say you're after Gunslinger, is that true?
Who is 'they'? Is Toad the one spreading rumors around? Is he the one telling people I want Gunslinger dead?

Oh, you know - the world is full of rumors... Half of them are bullshit, the other half are just waiting to get someone killed. \n \nBut still... interesting that this particular rumor is going around about you.

I don't know any Gunslinger... and I don't want to. \n \nPeople keep throwing that name at me like I'm supposed to know who the hell he is. But I don't. Right now I've got bigger things to worry about than some ghost from my missing memories.
Alright, alright... Relax. If you don't know, you don't know. \n \nSorry about that. Just had to check, just in case. You never know what's real and what's bullshit in the Zone these days.
And who exactly is this Gunslinger supposed to be? Why does everyone keep assuming I know him? I don't remember shit about the guy.

He used to hang around here, but it's been a while... 
 
Let's cut to the chase. I've overstayed my time here as it is. Stay put for a moment, would you? I wouldn't have lasted this long in the Zone if I wasn't careful every second - I'm sure you understand what I mean. 
 
I'll leave you the backpack, and we'll go our separate ways peacefully. It's not worth causing any problems. 
 
Oh, and tell Toad I said hello.
I got the backpack from Ferret by the bridge. Here it is. \n \nHe also sends his regards... What a strange character that guy is.

Yeah, he's a weird bastard, that Ferret. But like I said - you'd be fine. Ferret's not as bad as people make him out to be... most of the time. \n \nSo tell me... you didn't look in the backpack, did you?
Are you trying to catch me red-handed or something? No, I didn't look inside it. I just delivered the damn thing like you asked.
Huh... that's clever of you. You really didn't look inside the backpack at all? I was sure you'd check what was inside. Most people can't help themselves.
I think there are artifacts in it. There's this faint humming sound emanating from inside the backpack, and the whole thing is surprisingly heavy.
Fine, call them artifacts if that makes you happy. But tell me this instead - have you still not remembered your own damn name? Or who the hell Gunslinger is?

No, I still don't remember a damn thing. I still don't remember my own damn name, and I have no idea who the hell Gunslinger is. It's all blank up here... \n \nFerret has apparently met Gunslinger, though... This is really turning out to be a strange turn of events.
And you still don't remember how you ended up in the Death Truck either? I'm assuming nothing comes to mind about that either, huh?
No. I already told you - I don't remember a damn thing about the Death Truck. Not how I got in it, not what happened, nothing at all. It's all just blank.

Hopefully those memories of yours come back one day and you finally shake off this amnesia. 
 
For now, I've got one last job for you. Finish this one properly, and you'll be free to go wherever the hell you want... 
 
Until I need you again, of course.
Aren't you afraid that I might just leave and never come back? You say I'll be free to go after this job, but something tells me you'll find another reason to keep me around.

Afraid? Of you leaving? 
 
I'm not afraid at all. You stalkers need me way more than I need you. Without me, where the hell are you gonna get food, ammo, or medicine? Nowhere. 
 
Hopefully you're not stupid enough to try anything against me... You still owe me for saving your hide, remember that!
Alright... calm down, old man! I was only speaking hypothetically. Tell me - what do you need me to do?

I got a tip that there are some important documents at the Agroprom Research Institute. They might help us push further toward the center of the Zone. \n \nProblem is, it's a dangerous area. Not many people have returned from there since the last big emission.

The center of the Zone? What could possibly be worth going there for? \n \nCordon is already unpleasant, and we're still pretty far from the center. Pushing deeper just feels like asking to get yourself killed.

Heh-heh... The center of the Zone is a legendary place, kid! They say it's packed with artifacts and all sorts of wonders. Everything a man could want. There's even some fairy tale about a Wish-Granting Entity called the Monolith. I don't buy that crap for a second, though. \n \nThere are also stories about the stalker named Gunslinger who actually reached the Center... and then vanished.
Gunslinger was at the center of the Zone? \n \nWait a second... You're telling me the guy everyone keeps talking about actually made it all the way to the Center? And then he just vanished?

Yeah, I don't buy that thrice-born bullshit either. Some old legend about a guy who's supposed to change the whole Zone... Whatever, just drunk talk if you ask me. Let's cut the crap and get to business. 
 
This is your first real job, so listen up. I need you to head over to the Agroprom Research Institute and retrieve some important documents. They're in a plain white case, same kind as the one you brought me last time. Word is they're stashed somewhere in the western facility. 
 
Don't even think about going in there alone. Ask around the village first and find yourself a decent partner. And heads up - there's a big, nasty pack of dogs roaming the Garbage right now. Turned the whole area into a damn deathtrap. Plenty of rookies learned that the hard way. 
 
Oh yeah... and since I promised you some basic equipment... Here. Take these cans of concentrate, they may come in handy out there.

Okay, I think I can handle it. \n \nI'll head over to Agroprom, find those documents in the white case, and bring them back. I'll ask around the village and try to find a partner first - I don't plan on going in there alone.

Now that's a practical approach! Head north to the Garbage. Be careful - lots of thugs hanging around there lately. There are two ways west from the Garbage to the Research Institute: a hole in the fence or the main road further north. Both marked on your map. 
 
But listen up, the whole area around Agroprom is contaminated with deadly radiation. You'll start glowing like a Christmas tree in under a minute with just your regular gear. You need a proper protective suit in good condition or you'll be cooked alive. Prepare thoroughly - I don't need another corpse on my hands.
 
Oh, and the sniper has cleared the bridge, so you can pass safely. Now get moving, stalker.
I'm back. I think this is what you were looking for. \n \nTook me a while to find them. Some were hidden pretty well... almost as if someone didn't want them to be found. Anyway, here they are.
Okay. That's them. You look like you've been dragged through hell... \n \nAlright, I need some time to look these over. Come back to my place in an hour or so and we'll figure out what's next.
Okay, but I'm a bit worn out after that trip... and a bit low on cash at the moment.

Alright... Word on the street is a group of diggers had a staging area around here at the Cordon. They were pretty good at hiding, but nothing stays hidden forever in the Zone. They've been gone for ages now. 
 
They were holed up somewhere in the garages near the boiler room. The entrance is probably camouflaged, so keep your eyes peeled. 
 
Now leave me alone with these documents. Come back in about an hour.
So, what's up? I'm back after my extremely luxurious one-hour rest... \n \nDid you manage to make any sense of those documents while I was gone?

Yeah, there's good news and bad news... Bad news is, this looks like it's only part one of two. The good news? According to these documents, the second part is right here in Cordon. \n \nThey're supposed to be taken to the Mainland soon. You get the picture?
Gotcha. I'll grab the other documents.

Great. It should be at the military checkpoint. I recommend waiting until night, when most of them are fast asleep. The box itself is in the commander's office. \n \nAnd a big request - do everything quietly. No noise, no shooting, nothing. The last thing I need is them busting my door down. Act discreetly. The soldiers are on patrol, but they're mostly just going through the motions. There hasn't been a proper shift change in a long time.
Understood. I'll go grab them.
And one more thing - only kill soldiers as a last resort. I don't need any extra heat from them, understand?
Here's your box. Man, it was a real pain in the ass getting it, though.

All right! Okay. Uh-huh. It's all starting to make sense now... The military are clearly looking for something in the center... What the fuck do they want?! There's a lot of maps and scientific papers. You might want to show those papers to Barkeep.
Barkeep? Who's that? And where can I find him?

He's a solid guy, always gets shit done. Runs the 'Stalker' bar just past the Garbage. 

Here's the deal: take these papers to him. He'll be able to make more sense of them than I can. Besides, you've already made a good impression around here, so he'll definitely be willing to help. 
 
You handle yourself pretty well out there - not many can do what you do. That's exactly the kind of person the Barkeep needs.
Messer, you're just in time. Another job is brewing!
Hi.
Tell me about this place.

This is the road into the Zone. In the cellar behind the small village near the army checkpoint, you'll find a trader. I wouldn't recommend going near the checkpoint itself - the soldiers have orders to shoot stalkers on sight. Killing them is also a bad idea... unless it's your only choice. The trader has to pay for every soldier that dies, and he won't be happy about it. \n \nWatch out for the large packs of blind dogs roaming the plains. They're especially dangerous for rookies. Mutants don't come this far often, but it does happen.
This is truly useful information. Thank you.
What lies further up the road to the north? What should I watch out for if I keep going that way?

The Garbage lies further north. It's a dangerous and heavily contaminated place. Vast piles of radioactive waste and scrap have turned entire sections into impassable death traps. The radiation there is no joke - even with good gear, you can get cooked pretty quickly if you're not careful. \n \nOn top of that, the area is crawling with bandits, so expect trouble if you head that way.
What do you know about this place?

You know... it's not exactly a nice place, to put it mildly. Everyone calls this place a safe haven in the Zone, but I've seen some truly fucked up things happen here that would haunt a man for the rest of his days. 
 
Our boys may be in charge around here, but that's mostly just for show - for people like you and me. 
 
But when the Zone decides to take back what's hers... nothing and no one can stop it.
I don't understand... what do you mean?

At night, you shouldn't go wandering around the local apartments... \n \nIf you're planning to sleep here, it's much safer to stay at the bar or with us. The Barkeep has some stories about what happens after dark that would make even the toughest stalkers nervous!
I see... I heard it's not very safe around here at night. Is that true?

Yeah... it's true. It's not very safe around here at night. 
 
The Zone is the Zone, anything can happen. Our territory is one of the safer spots - only the mainland is calmer. 
 
But even here, strange shit goes down after dark. People whisper all kinds of crazy stories about what they've seen at night.
Stories? What stories?

Stories? Ah, well... I heard that not all the families evacuated after the accident. Some religious fanatics or sectarians stayed behind. Real strange, otherworldly people. 
 
They were living here even before the first stalkers arrived. Some old-timers claim they actually had contact with them. How they survived for so long is a mystery. Then one day... they just vanished. No one ever saw them again. 
 
That's why I always say - at night, it's better to stay somewhere crowded. Don't sleep in those old apartments. A lot of them are still locked up, and who knows what's inside.
The Barkeep's Story
Bar patrons and the Barkeep himself recommend spending the night in crowded places, as the local apartments may harbor dangerous secrets.

There's a house in the village just beyond the bridge. People say it's extremely radioactive. There's definitely something inside - normal thirty-year-old scrap wouldn't put out radiation like that, and it would've been looted a long time ago. \n \nLuckily, I managed to get my hands on a large transport capsule designed for highly radioactive materials. I think it'll be just right for the job.

Waste paper, huh? Well, well... Since your memory is clearly shot, let me explain it to you one more time... 
 
The real treasure in the Zone isn't guns, artifacts, or loot. It's information. A simple piece of paper can be worth more than all the gold in the world if it contains the right secrets. 
 
So if you find anything interesting around here, don't sell it to the first guy who offers you cash. Bring it straight to me. I'll pay you well for it. Sure, other traders might want it too, but I can always outbid them!

There's plenty to burn, alright. You got caught right in the middle of that blowout, you fool! It was a psi-wave. 
 
That shit kills everything in its path. Nobody really knows what it is or where it comes from, but most say it originates somewhere deep in the center of the Zone. 
 
Anyway... good job figuring out you need to hide when one of those hits - if you're still alive, that is.

I'll let you in on a secret: artifacts often appear after big emissions... And a lot of strange things happen to the creatures around here too. But I suppose you'll see it for yourself soon enough. \n \nOh, and one more thing about the artifacts - they say their properties can change over time. Sometimes they even disappear completely. Weird stuff happens to them. Anyway... consider yourself warned.

I'm telling you, it's all gone! Go search the village - maybe someone left some food behind. If not, you can always try catching rats or crows... if you're lucky enough to hit one, heh-heh. Or just trade with the guys around here. They usually have something to eat. 
 
But keep this in mind: almost everything you find out there is probably radioactive. Half the bushes in the Zone are irradiated. Sure, if you look hard enough you might find something cleaner, but I still wouldn't recommend eating random junk you pick up off the ground. 
 
You think I'm sitting here for the scenery? For miles around, I'm the only place where you can get halfway decent food... usually clean, if you're lucky. 
 
And to check if something's radioactive, just scan it in your backpack. Make sure you've got a dosimeter on you. If it's contaminated, you'll hear a beep.

Are you kidding me? You really don't know? The radiation levels around the Research Institute are insane - high enough to fry an egg on the ground. I'm not crazy enough to go in there without proper protection. You need something better than a leather jacket, at least a decent stalker suit. That's the bare minimum. 
 
You might want to check with Toad. I heard someone brought one to him recently. 
 
Oh, and besides the suit, I also need a gravity artifact. It's incredibly useful for raids and expeditions. They do make you hungrier than usual, but that's a small price to pay. If you can't find a normal one, two weaker ones will do just fine.

Messer, you near the tunnel? Do me a favor - if you've got a spare discharger, clear that anomaly inside. One of my couriers from the Bar should be passing through soon, and that's the only route he uses. Do this for me and I'll make it worth your while.

Hmm, no one knows the full story, but there's a dark tale about him. They say he was cursed. Everyone who got close to him ended up dead or missing. His friends started having nightmares - hearing voices, seeing things that shouldn't exist. Then they lost their minds. Some shot themselves. One went completely mad and started smearing the walls of his cottage with blood and shit. The rest just vanished. \n \nThen one day the stalker himself disappeared. He went to sleep in a small room and was gone by morning, leaving all his gear neatly laid out like he was just stepping out for a minute.
Trapped soldiers

A group of soldiers has fallen into a trap near the end of the railway tunnel. They're surrounded by a dense cluster of anomalies. One of them - probably the commander - is asking for someone to run to Toad. Apparently he thinks Toad can help them.

In exchange for helping me, I want you to bring me a "Dead Head" artifact. Yeah, that's its name. Don't worry, I'm not asking you to go around chopping heads off... though with you, I wouldn't be surprised. 
 
If you're short on cash, the artifact will do just fine. I need them pretty badly. But if you'd rather pay normally, I've got a set rate for every kill, plus a little extra for my own hard work. 
 
One more thing: if you're part of a faction, completing this 'atonement' will strip you of your rank and make you neutral again. Don't count on them welcoming you back with open arms after that.
I was hoping you could answer a few questions I have, Toad.

You understand how it is - I sit on my ass here all day, but the real shit happens out there in the Zone. I can give you the general rundown, or I can tell you about the places around here that I've actually walked myself.
Tell me a little about the Zone. I've heard all sorts of stories, but I want to hear it from someone who actually knows.
Go ahead and ask.
What are the military doing in the Zone anyway? I mean, why are they even here? What do they actually want?

They're guarding, that's what they're doing. Whether they're protecting the Zone or protecting the world from it... who the hell knows. 
 
Expeditions pass through here from time to time. But those Ukrainian soldiers don't respect the Zone, and the Zone sure as hell doesn't respect them back. 
 
They look down on us stalkers like we're nothing, acting like gods. They won't lift a finger to help you even if you're dying right in front of them, but they'll shoot you dead without hesitation. 
 
I've managed to find some common ground with a few of them, though. After all, where else are they gonna get their vodka and dirty magazines? Just don't provoke them for no reason - they'll swat you aside without a second thought.
Tell me more about the Zone.

The Zone... It's not just some random stretch of land around the old power plant. It's something much weirder than that. Truth be told, I don't think anyone in the outside world could really explain what it is. The Zone feels like its own separate reality - dangerous, unpredictable, and strangely addictive. \n \nAnd you know why it pulls so many people in? Because here, if you get lucky, even a nobody can strike it rich overnight. The closer you get to the Center, the faster the money finds you.
What is so dangerous about this "separate reality" that you speak of?

Dangerous? Where do I even begin... 
 
You can die at any moment out here, and not just from a soldier's bullet - though there are plenty of trigger-happy bastards around. Getting shot is actually one of the cleaner ways to go. The anomalies are a whole different nightmare. They can crush you, melt you, or rip you apart in ways you don't want to imagine. Even the mutants steer clear of them. 
 
Speaking of mutants, they're nasty pieces of work - the real children of the Zone. So don't wander around unarmed if you value your life. 
 
If you want the full picture of how the Zone kills, ask the other stalkers. They've got stories that would make your skin crawl.
How does one actually get rich here in the Zone?

Well, buddy, that amnesia of yours must really be kicking your ass. Don't you remember? 
 
Artifacts, kid. Artifacts! That's the real gold in the Zone. People from the Mainland will pay insane amounts for any weird trinket we drag out of here. They're worth more than gold, diamonds, or plutonium combined. 
 
Why? Because these things have powers you won't find anywhere else in the world. Hang the right one on your belt and bullets might start missing you. Some can heal you, boost your strength, or do all kinds of crazy shit. That's why they're so valuable. 
 
You can find basic ones right around here, close to home. But if you want the really good stuff - the ones that can make you rich - you have to push deeper toward the center of the Zone.
Does anyone know what goes on in the center of the Zone?

People talk all kinds of shit if you ask them. You'll hear every wild story imaginable... but I don't buy most of that supernatural nonsense! \n \nWhat I do know is that the Center is supposed to be full of incredibly valuable artifacts. The catch is, I haven't met a single person who's actually made it back from there alive.
Do you know what happened to me?

Well, you sure asked the right question, buddy. It's a shady business, you know... 
 
We found you in what they call a "Death Truck." Those are usually old ZILs that come rolling out from the center of the Zone every now and then, loaded with bodies. No one knows where they're headed. One of them crashed, and you were found amongst the wreckage. That's the crazy part - they've found wrecked Death Trucks before, but never anyone alive inside. 
 
Sorry, kid. That's all I know. You'll have to figure the rest out for yourself.
So... who's this "Gunslinger" guy?

A well-known stalker... They say he's one of the few who actually reached the center of the Zone and made it back alive. 
 
Of course, around here there are more legends about heroic stalkers than actual heroes. 
 
As for me, I've never done business with him. Seems he has his own channels. Ask around the Zone - someone might know more about him.
Tell me about the stalker named Ghost.

Oh, he's another legendary figure! \n \nStories about him were everywhere a couple years back. Some say he was one of the best, others claim he was just incredibly lucky. Though now that I think about it, nothing's been heard of him in quite a while. He probably got killed somewhere deep within the Zone. The Zone has a way of swallowing up even the strongest stalkers eventually.
What's going on around here?

Ah, this is the entry to the Zone - the Cordon. It's relatively quiet here, except for the occasional military types amusing themselves by shaking everyone down. 
 
Experienced stalkers are rare in these parts. Mostly just rookies hanging around, and some of them end up staying for good. There's a small rookie camp at the farmstead nearby - they know how to shoot, so don't go looking for trouble. 
 
Across the road is an abandoned factory. To the north, beyond the railway embankment, you'll find the remains of a village. South is a military checkpoint. And right in the center there's a bridge with a lone watchtower beside it. 
 
That about covers everything.
Tell me more about the military checkpoint down the road.

There's a dozen soldiers posted at that checkpoint with orders to shoot anything that moves, so you'd best stay far away from it. 
 
If you piss them off, they'll call in the Special Forces from their outpost. Those bastards will rip the place apart so bad I won't see a single customer for a month. 
 
I know their commander a bit - the guy's a heavy drinker. Truth is, it's mostly thanks to him that I'm still able to keep my head down and operate here.
Tell me more about the railroad bridge. It looks pretty dangerous.

The railroad bridge? It's just a short walk north from here - you'll spot it right away. \n \nI'm not entirely positive, but I think I've seen experienced stalkers use the old railway tracks as a route. There might even be some kind of trail running along them. Just be careful if you head that way...
Whats going on over at the factory?

Once you cross the street, you'll see the factory right away - that big brick building with the large smoke stacks. Anything worth stealing from there was looted a long time ago. Now it's mostly just an empty shell. \n \nIt's become a favorite hangout for bandits and thugs. I don't know if any are there right now, but you'd better be careful. There's nothing for them to take from you... but do you really want the hassle of dealing with them?
Tell me about the village.

You're such a bore, you know that? \n \nIt's just another shithole village like all the rest in the Zone. A few rotten houses, some broken fences, and a busted well - nothing worth writing home about. All the drunks there kicked the bucket long before Perestroika even started. Radiation or anomalies probably finished off whoever was dumb enough to stick around.
Thank you, that's all the questions I have for now.
There's something else I'd like to know.
Regarding the anomaly in the tunnel.
